text:
Maya Patel: Quick flag — audit exports don't include a discrete 'route_policy' or 'rollout_id' field when someone changes routing/quota rules in Console. We're getting questions from compliance about 'who changed traffic split vs. who changed model variant'. Need to decide schema + UI surface for this.

Tomás Ortega: Agreed. We currently jam that into a generic 'metadata.change' blob. Pain to query.

Irene Chen: +1. For audits we need structured fields: event_type, actor_id, actor_display, target_type, target_id, field_changed, old_value, new_value, rollout_id (optional), policy_id. Also timestamp and request_id.

Samir Khan: Should we include a 'routing_context' object that has: route_policy, percent, model_variant, destination_pool? Otherwise exports can't correlate a 'split' change to the canary.

Maya Patel: I prefer flat keys for CSV friendliness, e.g., routing_policy, routing_percent, model_variant, pool — but NDJSON export can keep nested. We should support both.

Tomás Ortega: Proposal: internal API change only — add normalized fields on the event envelope but keep raw change blob for full fidelity. That avoids breaking old parsers.

Irene Chen: Important: actor_id mapping with SSO/SCIM. When someone acts via API key or automation, we need actor_type (user, service, system) + provenance (console|api|jobs). Compliance will ask for both.

Samir Khan: On deduping: when a rollout pipeline updates 50 targets in quick succession, we should coalesce into a single 'rollout.batch' event with an items_count and a compact diff. Otherwise export explodes.

Maya Patel: Good point. Maybe two event flavors: atomic_change (single field) and batch_change (rollout_id + summary + per-item hash link).

Tomás Ortega: Implementation note — the audit-log microservice currently writes events to kafka topic 'audit.v1' with schema v1. We'll bump to v2 that includes the new fields and add a compatibility flag. Need to document and add migration path for export consumers.

Samir Khan: API for exports: streaming NDJSON over an authenticated /audit/exports endpoint with query params (since, until, event_type, actor, rollout_id) + pagination token. CSV generation can be a background job with a link.

Irene Chen: Retention: default 90 days in hosted, 365 for enterprise. But exports should be able to include snapshots from private deployments. Also need an 'export_audit_trail' permission separate from read config.

Maya Patel: UX side: Console should show the canonical 'audit line' on top of a config page — e.g., "Last changed by Irene Chen via console (rollout: r-1234) — View full audit". Also make the field-level diff queryable.

Tomás Ortega: For the UI diff, we'll expose an endpoint /audit/diff?target=route:route-342&since=... that returns a compact list of changes. Cache diffs for 24h to save DB hits.

Samir Khan: Telemetry: emit metric audit.export.size, audit.events.coalesced, audit.query.latency — so we can set SLOs and alert on export backpressure. Also throttle exports per-org via quota.

Irene Chen: On quotas: exports are heavy. We need org-level rate limits and a monthly export bytes quota; show usage on billing dashboard. Also include estimated size before export triggers so users can choose NDJSON vs CSV.

Maya Patel: Security note: don't include full secret blobs in 'old_value'/'new_value'. Mask tokens, credentials. We should also detect when a change touches a KMS/HSM key binding and mark the event as sensitive.

Tomás Ortega: Example audit event (NDJSON single-line example):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01GZ9X1",
  "timestamp": "2026-01-12T18:24:12Z",
  "event_type": "config.change",
  "actor_id": "usr_77a",
  "actor_display": "Irene Chen",
  "actor_type": "user",
  "provenance": "console",
  "target_type": "route_policy",
  "target_id": "rp-342",
  "routing_policy": "weighted_split",
  "routing_percent": "10->90",
  "rollout_id": "r-1234",
  "field_changed": "splits",
  "old_value_summary": "[{v: \"v1\", p:90}, {v:\"v2\", p:10}]",
  "new_value_summary": "[{v:\"v1\", p:10}, {v:\"v2\", p:90}]",
  "request_id": "req-9f1",
  "raw_blob_link": "s3://audit-raw/2026/01/12/evt_01GZ9X1.json"
}
```

Irene Chen: That looks good. Make sure raw_blob_link respects tenant encryption and ACLs.

Samir Khan: Ops question — do we need to backfill old events with new fields? Backfilling 1 year of events is heavy. I vote we add normalization layer in exports: when exporting, we translate old events into the new flat shape where possible and mark 'normalized: true' on the export rows. Backfill only for enterprise customers on request.

Maya Patel: Action items: Tomás + Samir to spec the api/schema changes and migration plan. Irene + Maya to mock console diff UI + permission. I'll collect compliance reqs and draft a short doc for export consumers.

Tomás Ortega: I'll open a PR with schema v2 draft and a sample migration script.

Samir Khan: I'll add metrics to the audit producer and a quota check in export service.

deploy-bot: deploy status: audit-producer v1.5 -> v2 staging queued by @Tomás Ortega :rocket:

AuditBot: Note: export endpoints currently limited to 5 concurrent jobs per-org.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — let's sync Friday 10am to review PR + mockups. :thumbsup:

Tomás Ortega: Sounds good. If anyone has specific compliance fields they need (e.g., legal_case_id, retention_override_reason) drop them here.

Irene Chen: I'll add a short list.

Samir Khan: Putting a TODO in the repo for coalescing logic.

Maya Patel: End of thread.
